kind: Pinned touch controller and keyboard bridge firmware identities; not a redistribution license
source: odm_a firmware directory: novatek_nt36532_piano_fw_csot.bin and novatek_nt36532_piano_fw_boe.bin (touch firmware for the CSOT and BOE panels) and MCU_Upgrade.bin (Nanosic keyboard bridge application), names unchanged
selection: Requested through the firmware-name properties of the piano device tree; the touch driver picks the CSOT or BOE entry from the panel ID pin. Touch calibration is per-device input generated by tools/extract-thp-calibration.py and is not part of this tree.
